responsibility: This file defines the N8 core pipeline model for the NDS32 scheduler. It introduces the two-stage II/EX automaton, reservation patterns for loads, stores, multiple-memory instructions, multiply/MAC/divide, and branches, and bypass predicates that distinguish address-generation, post-update, and data-result hazards, so GCC can schedule code according to the N8 microarchitecture rather than the even simpler N7 or E8/N10-family models.
